claim: The pinned LoRAcles checkpoint sometimes identifies broad training topics in these Qwen3-14B toys, but does not reliably describe precise behavior changes and invents unsupported details. No general verdict on LoRAcles.
primary_limitation: All primary replies violated the exact one-letter format. Planned 0/24 and degenerate permutation p=1 retained; this does not show zero semantic recognition or chance-level understanding. No valid primary statistical verdict.

post_hoc_assisted_recognition.status: Retrospective phrase/letter parsing after format failure. Descriptive only. Offered task list, no significance claim; not open-description accuracy.

specific_findings: Released-format capital topic recognized for all three initial capital runs, but generated details include invented names and nonexistent other training facts.

Initial creature-diet topic recognized even though all three first-phase diet models missed the strong-learning gate. This is consistent with detecting training topic rather than validating learned behavior.
Capitals-to-diets adjacent category recognized3/3, diets-to-capitals0/3 despite strong new-capital learning3/3.
All first-phase numbered/bullets/uppercase categories missed by released sentence review; all three seeds learned these tasks strongly.
Zero update yielded a confident story about a1973FordMustang, and its assisted answer claimed numbered lists. Zero is also out of interpreter training distribution.
Formatting trajectories damaged single-word controls. These are strong but not clean selective interventions.
limitations: One base model and interpreter checkpoint, three initialization seeds, reused task vocabulary, exploratory synthetic data.
No known published positive benchmark replicated.
Adjacent rank32 effective differences reduced to16 per module; minimum retained matrixenergy96.995%, mean99.590%, which is not a behavior guarantee.
Secondary corrected SVD encoding was not promoted over original released input format.
Sentence parsing and examples cannot establish a preregistered above-chance result.
next_step: No additional experiments launched. Preserve fixed suite and report limitations; any further study requires new user direction.
